en.question: Which prompt is most likely to produce consistent, usable output?

options.text: "Summarise this document accurately and completely for a business reader."
options.note: "Accurately and completely" is unmeasurable and fixes no format.

options.text: "Give me a really good summary of this document, thorough but also concise."
options.note: "Thorough but concise" is contradictory and gives no structure.

options.text: "Summarise this document. Keep the tone professional and the length sensible."
options.note: "Professional" and "sensible" are subjective and will drift between calls.

options.text: "Summarise in three bullets under 20 words each: decision, owner, deadline."

en.explanation: Specificity about structure, length, and required content is what makes output consistent and machine-consumable. It states the format, the size bound, and exactly which facts must appear.
